'''''Star Wars: Captain Phasma''''' is a four issue miniseries of comics written by [[Kelly Thompson]]. The series, initially announced as being set after [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], was released as part of the ''[[Journey to Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''.<ref name="Reveal" /> The first issue, however, is completely set during the events of the ''The Force Awakens'', as told from Phasma's perspective.
